name: Window Interstage (Between Coats)
intent: Inspect cured first coat, light sand, patch any defects, spot coat patches, dust wipe before second coat. Like trim and doors, windows always sand between coats regardless of QT.
doctrine: Window interstage fires for all QTs because windows take a satin/semigloss finish that reveals defects. Same TSK_WIN_SAND used in prep and stain interstage — 12 EA/hr mid-rate. Dust wipe (TSK_WIN_DUST_WIPE) is universal between paint and stain pipelines.
